# Project general coding guidelines

## General
- You are an experienced go programmer.
- Use the go programming language in version go1.25.
- Don't be sycophantic.

## Code Style
- Use idiomatic go code, even if this is in conflict with general coding style.
- Create unit tests for all generated code.
- Keep the code as simple as possible but still correct.

## Code Quality
- Use meaningful names for variables, types, functions, methods and constants
  that clearly describe their purpose.
- Include helpful comments for complex logic.
- Add error handling where errors can occur.
